stages.proves: both nodes on the same build, funded, connected to each other and to the hub

stages.proves: v2 open (open_channel2 / interactive-tx) where both sides contribute inputs; public channel announced at 6 confirmations

stages.stage: P2-2 payments both ways and through the hub
stages.proves: HTLCs both directions on the new channel, forwarding by FAFO to and from the faucet hub; the hub routes to FAFO2 from its gossip graph (hint-free invoice)

FAFO2 -> FAFO -> faucet LND hub (faucet invoice)

results.pass1_channel_closed: cooperative close b078b3cb... at 06:22:02Z, confirmed in 3462144, Closed by 06:26Z

stages.stage: P2-3 FAFO splices in 100,000 sat
stages.proves: splice-in with a wallet input (splice_init/ack, interactive-tx on the shared input), channel usable while pending, lock at depth 3, new SCID announced at depth 6, old SCID retired for 72 blocks

stages.stage: P2-4 FAFO2 splices out 50,000 sat to a FAFO address
stages.proves: splice-out paying an external address, fee from the splicer's channel balance, amount received on chain

results.announced: never: replaced by the P2-5 lock before its 6th confirmation (BOLT 7 announces at 6)

stages.stage: P2-5 restart drill mid-splice
stages.proves: a node stopped with a signed, unconfirmed splice resumes it: channel_reestablish, splice_locked retransmitted, lock completes; NL-517 fix live (FAFO2 restarted while its own splice-out was the current funding and kept its kind/key index at the next lock)

results.reconnect: FAFO's backoff redialed at 06:32:13Z (FAFO2 never dials FAFO, a loopback inbound-only peer)

stages.stage: P2-6 setchannelpolicy
stages.proves: a per-channel routing policy change is signed, sent as channel_update and seen by the network

results.other_values: fee 1000 msat + 1 ppm, cltv delta 40, htlc min 1000 msat (node defaults, unchanged)
results.seen_by_FAFO2: 06:32:49Z (graph policy 2->1 htlc 1000-150000000); before: 1000-280000000 on every earlier SCID (e.g. 3462145x9x1 at 06:25:36Z)
results.seen_by_network: mutinynet.com (its own LND, fed by the hub) lists NLightningFAFO max_htlc 150,000,000 on 3462164x1x0 at 06:43Z; pass 1 showed the same on 3462104x1x1 by 06:1xZ

stages.stage: P2-6b splice RBF drill
stages.proves: bumpsplice: an RBF attempt replaces the first in the mempool, both nodes follow both attempts, payments keep working while both are pending, only the bump confirms and locks

results.T1: f7d54bb2... 253 sat/kw, left the mempool when T2 arrived, never confirmed, marked Abandoned by the chain monitor after the lock

stages.stage: P2-7 hub routes over the final SCID
stages.proves: the faucet hub pays FAFO2 through FAFO over the spliced channel

payments.route: faucet LND hub -> FAFO -> FAFO2 (invoice with an r hint over 3462164x1x0: new SCID, inside the 10 min grace period)

final_state.note: after one more FAFO->FAFO2 1,000 sat payment f099d9414a885bf545bdf6085b583f99e86ddb1f955ffd189804e8f5d5db7f6a on the NL-519 build

failed_pass.summary: every step passed on the wire; the restart drill exposed NL-517 (FAFO2's row of its own splice-out 2cb71d6b rewritten as kind Initial / key index 0 at the next lock), fixed in d5be5b73; the RBF bump was mined 11 s after it, before the payments; the channel was closed cooperatively during pass 2

run2_net11.title: Mutinynet dry run 2 on the .NET 11 build (DAY0_RUNBOOK.md §2.2, §5)

build.target: net11.0, dotnet publish -c Release -r osx-arm64 --self-contained true (SDK 11.0.100-rc.1.26425.128, Microsoft.NETCore.App 11.0.0-rc.1.26425.128)
build.staged: ~/.nltg/mutinynet/bin-2a209a5e-net11 and ~/.nltg/mutinynet-fafo2/bin-2a209a5e-net11 (daemon/, client/, commit, runtime), each node's bin-current
build.previous: dbbcba28 on net10.0 (framework-dependent), bin-dbbcba28 kept for rollback

run2_net11.config_changes: both appsettings.json: Node:Features:AllowExperimentalFeatures removed (D13 defaults), Node:DualFund:AllowRbf false -> true (the first run's configs had it false, which refuses bumpopen); Splice:MinRbfInterval 00:00:05 kept; previous files appsettings.json.pre-net11

channels_opened.f20939f0c87038c0aec6c2de0587d20dd93b2acc: P2-1a, no RBF, 3463271x11x0, 350,000 sat, kept open
channels_opened.b78b95b78756fd2b1db8f1c4027d935454131ebb: P2-1, RBF by both sides, then every splice; 3463315x4x1, 459,816 sat

stages.stage: U0 upgrade in place to the .NET 11 build
stages.proves: both nodes stopped with nodectl, cold backups, bin-current switched to the self-contained net11.0 build, migration AddDualFundAttempts applied at start, every open channel reestablished with unchanged balances and commitment numbers, gossip synced
commands: jq 'del(.Node.Features.AllowExperimentalFeatures) | .Node.DualFund.AllowRbf = true' (both configs; previous file appsettings.json.pre-net11)
